title: Patch: Paranoia's set Spells resolve when set and again when revealed
thread:
**Issue #3806 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3806: Patch: Paranoia's set Spells resolve when set and again when revealed
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

**1. Under Paranoia, a Spell takes effect twice.** A Spell set face-down by its Cloaked while a Paranoia (Meditative #99, `meditative-099`) acts on its controller's field resolves **once when it is set** and **again when it is revealed** by its Activate: Reveal.

Today the Spell declares nothing when set and resolves only on its reveal (§8 Meditative row 99, R1044, R783004, R783006). The reveal stays as it is: prompts in order (R467), Echo, Radiant Paranoia's Echo +{echo} (R1045), effects from a Trap, then to the graveyard (R766). The new resolution is added at the set. After it resolves, the card stays set face-down in its backrow zone, counted as a Trap play and a Trap on the field exactly as it is today.

Suggested card text (the builder settles the wording and puts it on the card, since it changes how the card plays): base "Aura: Your Spells have Cloaked. Spells you set face-down resolve as you set them and again as you reveal them. Cry: Draw {draw}." The Radiant face keeps its extra "Spells you reveal have Echo +{echo}".

The builder makes these decisions and writes each down in a ruling in this issue's block, R3806000+:
- **Which Spells.** Only those set while a Paranoia acts on their controller's field when they are set. A Spell set by a Cloaked from a Buff in hand (R2727000) with no Paranoia out gets no set-time resolution. A set Spell whose Paranoia has left by the time it reveals still resolves on its reveal, as today.
- **Choices at the set.** The set-time resolution asks for its targets, modes and X as prompts, as the reveal does (R467). Recommendation: the set is offered only where the Spell's required declarations have a legal pick (R703's test, as the reveal's `reveal_can_complete` uses). Say whether an X or embiggen chosen at the set also applies to the reveal.
- **Where the effects come from.** Recommendation: from a Trap at both resolutions (no Spell Damage; Immune to Spells does not stop them), matching the reveal (R781001). The card's own Echo repeats on each resolution. Radiant Paranoia's bonus applies only to the reveal, as its text says.
- **Hidden information.** The set-time resolution is public, so its effects show which Spell it was. Decide what `view_for` shows the opponent: the card named while it resolves, then hidden again as a set Trap, or never named. CLAUDE.md rule 7 applies: the client never sees what the view hides.
- **"This turn"** in its text means the set turn for the first resolution and the reveal turn for the second. A destination the text names ("shuffle it into your deck") applies only on the reveal. At the set, the card stays in the backrow.
- **Counting.** The set-time resolution is no second play. The set is still one Trap play, and the reveal is still no play (R70).

**2. Playing a card as a Trap runs no Cry. Make this explicit and guard it.** Today no Trap or Field Trap in `catalog.json` prints a Cry. Cloaked Units and Field Spells that have one (Vxyl `stinkyscape-103`, Gokugains `stinkyscape-123`, Knowledge Breaker Prime `meditative-045-1` when lent Cloaked, Paranoia itself when Buffed Cloaked) run their Cry on reveal, never when set (R783006, `cry_trigger::cry_place_of`). Keep it that way. No card is reworded.

The new set-time resolution in part 1 reuses the engine's Spell-text hook, which is `Script.cry` (`cry_place_of`'s `revealing` branch, R1044). It must not make a set Unit's or Field Spell's Cry fire. Write down the rule as part of the same ruling: "a card played face-down as a Trap runs no Cry at its play; an effect a Trap is meant to have when set is written `When played face down:`". Add a guard so no Trap gets a Cry later: `cargo jackioh catalog check` fails on a Trap or Field Trap whose base or Radiant text holds `Cry:`.

## Acceptance

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c099_paranoia.rs` tests, base and Radiant: a Spell set under Paranoia resolves at the set (its targets prompted) and again at the reveal. Radiant adds its Echo only at the reveal. A Spell set with no Paranoia out, via a Buffed Cloaked, resolves only at the reveal.
- An engine rule test (`crates/engine/tests/rules/cloaked.rs` or a sibling) proves that setting a Cloaked Unit and a Cloaked Field Spell with a Cry runs no Cry at the set, and runs it on reveal as before (R783006).
- The proving tests are named after the new ruling (`fn r3806000_…`). The ruling note goes in `spec/rulings/`, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/3806.md`. The §8 Meditative row 99, R1044's note, R783004 ("declares nothing when set") and R783006 are updated to match. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- The card text change is in `catalog.json` / `card-text.yaml` with its pending fragment (`cargo jackioh patches "<title>" --plays meditative-099`). `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh names --check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` pass.
- `catalog check` rejects a Trap or Field Trap text holding `Cry:`, with a test.
- The AI values the set-time resolution of its own set Spells (`crates/ai`; hidden cards still change no decision). `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` pass. If the golden replay moves, re-record it and say why in the pull request.

## Links

Builds on #781 / #783 (Cloaked, Paranoia's Aura).
```
